description: A WordPress plugin for the app: data model (post type and registered meta), a REST route and an Ability, each with a permission check, plus WordPress Coding Standards, PHPStan and Composer scripts. Activate it with WP-CLI; add tests with `wp scaffold plugin-tests <slug>`.

placeholders.slug: plugin folder and text domain, lowercase with dashes, e.g. book-club
placeholders.name: human-readable plugin name, e.g. Book Club
placeholders.prefix: PHP prefix, lowercase with underscores, derived from slug, e.g. book_club
placeholders.namespace: PHP namespace, derived from slug, e.g. BookClub

next: Rename the example post type, meta, route and ability to the app's real model; delete what the app does not need.
Copy the files to wp-content/plugins/{{slug}}/ and run: wp plugin activate {{slug}}
Developers: composer install && composer lint && composer stan
Add tests: wp scaffold plugin-tests {{slug}} (PHPUnit with the WordPress test suite).
